It now contains deferred candidate-runtime loading, parent-context validation, direct runtime-binding checks, absolute bound Git execution, private closure verification, parent tooling authentication, and direct `runtimeBindingDigest` propagation into preparation, compilation, approval, and path outputs.

## Stable Incomplete State

The verifier's unsafe static imports were removed, but its pre-import parent-context bootstrap was not completed. It currently has unset runtime and harness bindings, so it is not runnable and must not be integrated. Direct runtime-digest propagation into verifier checks and the final handoff report also remains unfinished.

`package.json`, `test/v12-release-review.test.mjs`, and `test/v12-release-gate.test.mjs` remain unchanged. The frozen adversarial tests, package command and format/lint wiring, focused tests, offline installation proof, template checker, format, lint, typecheck, build, full tests, and final diff inspection remain outstanding.

## Route

Outcome is `fix`. Resume from this exact diff, complete the verifier bootstrap before any candidate import, finish direct runtime identity reconstruction across prior phase artifacts, add the frozen adversarial coverage and package wiring, then run every Revision 18 command. Do not preserve or integrate the current partial implementation as passing evidence.
